scenes.prompt: A single large clay diya glowing at the doorstep of a traditional Indian home at dusk, rangoli around it, rows of small diyas along the steps, marigold torans on the door, calm warm evening light
scenes.animate: the diya flames flicker gently and the warm light softly breathes while the camera slowly pushes in

scenes.tts: ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय। छोटी दिवाली की शुभकामनाएँ।
